# Living Design System — Everyday-sans

Walmart's brand font, packaged by Living Design.

## Usage

### Android

1. Ensure the project is configured to use Walmart's Proximity repository. Add in [a Maven repository](https://docs.gradle.org/current/userguide/declaring_repositories.html#sec:maven_repo) in `build.gradle`:

   ```groovy
   allprojects {
       repositories {
           maven { url walmartArtifactoryRepository }
       }
   }
   ```

   Then, set `walmartArtifactoryRepository` in `gradle.properties`:

   ```ini
   walmartArtifactoryRepository=https://mvn.ci.artifacts.walmart.com/artifactory/livingdesign-mvn
   ```

2. Add the library as a dependency in `app/build.gradle`:

   ```groovy
   dependencies {
       compile 'com.walmart.android.ld:everyday-sans:0.0.0'
   }
   ```

   Check the [repository's release page](https://gecgithub01.walmart.com/LivingDesign/everyday-sans/releases) to find the latest version.

3. Use in a [`TextView`](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/widget/TextView):

   ```xml
   <TextView
       android:fontFamily="@font/everyday_sans"
       android:layout_width="fill_parent"
       android:layout_height="wrap_content"
       android:text="Hello, everyday-sans!" />
   ```

   The available font resources:

   | Name               | Resource                                        |
   |--------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
   | Everyday Sans      | `android:fontFamily="@font/everyday_sans"`      |
   | Everyday Sans Text | `android:fontFamily="@font/everyday_sans_text"` |
   | Everyday Sans Mono | `android:fontFamily="@font/everyday_sans_mono"` |

### Web

1. Install the package:

   ```shell
   # yarn
   yarn add @livingdesign/everyday-sans

   # npm
   npm install @livingdesign/everyday-sans
   ```

2. Add the CSS `@font-face` files that you need:

   ```js
   // EverydaySans
   import '@livingdesign/everyday-sans/dist/EverydaySans.css';

   // EverydaySans Mono
   import '@livingdesign/everyday-sans/dist/EverydaySansMono.css';
   ```

   **Note:** Only import CSS files for required application fonts to ensure unused webfonts aren't loaded.

3. Use the `font-family` in your application's styles:

   | Name              | `font-family`                               |
   | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
   | EverydaySans      | `font-family: EverydaySans, sans-serif;`    |
   | EverydaySans Mono | `font-family: EverydaySansMono, monospace;` |
